notes: Controlled vocabulary for Science of Placebo tagging. Every axis is multi-valued unless 'multi' is false. Chip color = axis color (one hue per axis); the 'effects' axis is the one exception with value-level colors. Colors give light-mode and dark-mode (bg, fg) pairs.

chip_style.light: background = bg, text/border = fg, border 1px, radius 999px, font 12px/600

values.label: Placebo effect
values.def: Causal effect of a placebo/context manipulation vs. a reduced, augmented, or absent context (controlled comparison; Wager & Atlas 2015).

values.label: Nocebo effect
values.def: Causal adverse effect of a negative context/expectation manipulation vs. control.

values.label: Placebo response
values.def: Improvement in a placebo/sham arm relative to baseline without a no-treatment control; includes predictors and magnitude of placebo response in trials.

values.label: Nocebo response
values.def: Adverse events or symptom worsening in a placebo/sham arm relative to baseline.

values.label: Placebo + nocebo
values.def: Both positive and negative expectation/context effects or responses are studied in the same paper.

values.label: Placebo science (other)
values.def: Ethics, clinical use, attitudes, definitions, history, or methodology of placebo research without measuring an effect or response.

values.label: Empirical
values.def: New data collected for this study (experiment, trial, survey, qualitative).

values.label: Secondary analysis
values.def: Re-analysis of existing trial/cohort data (e.g., placebo-arm analyses, IPD, registry).

values.label: Meta-analysis
values.def: Quantitative pooling of studies (with or without systematic search).

values.label: Systematic review
values.def: Systematic search and synthesis without quantitative pooling.

values.label: Review
values.def: Narrative or scoping review of a topic.

values.label: Theory / commentary
values.def: Conceptual, theoretical, opinion, perspective, or debate piece.

values.label: Protocol
values.def: Registered study protocol or design paper without results.

values.label: Case report
values.def: Single case or small case series.

values.label: Methods
values.def: Development or validation of measures, paradigms, or analysis methods for placebo research.

values.label: Editorial / letter
values.def: Editorial, letter to the editor, or reply.

values.label: Human
values.def: Human participants or human data.

values.label: Animal
values.def: Non-human animals (rodent, primate, dog, etc.), including conditioned pharmacological responses.

values.label: Computational
values.def: Simulation or modeling without new biological data.

values.label: N/A
values.def: Reviews/commentaries not tied to a species.

values.label: Healthy adults
values.def: Healthy volunteers roughly 18-64 y.

values.label: Healthy children/adolescents
values.def: Healthy participants under 18 y.

values.label: Healthy older adults
values.def: Healthy participants roughly 65+ y.

values.label: Chronic pain
values.def: Persistent pain conditions: low back pain, fibromyalgia, osteoarthritis, neuropathic pain, migraine/headache, TMD, etc.

values.label: Acute clinical pain
values.def: Postoperative, procedural, labor, dental, or injury pain in patients.

values.label: Chronic fatigue
values.def: ME/CFS, cancer-related fatigue, or other chronic fatigue populations.

values.label: Depression
values.def: Major depression or depressive symptoms as the sampled population.

values.label: Anxiety disorders
values.def: GAD, panic, social anxiety, phobias, OCD-spectrum.

values.label: PTSD / stress
values.def: Trauma- and stress-related disorders.

values.label: Cancer
values.def: Oncology patients (symptoms, side effects, survivorship).

values.label: Parkinson / movement
values.def: Parkinson's disease, dystonia, tremor, other movement disorders.

values.label: Other neurological
values.def: MS, epilepsy, stroke, TBI, dementia, restless legs, etc.

values.label: GI / IBS
values.def: Irritable bowel syndrome, functional dyspepsia, IBD, nausea populations.

values.label: Allergy / respiratory
values.def: Asthma, allergic rhinitis, COPD, cough.

values.label: Cardiovascular
values.def: Hypertension, angina, heart failure, cardiac surgery.

values.label: Sleep
values.def: Insomnia and other sleep disorders.

values.label: Substance use
values.def: Alcohol, nicotine, opioid, or other substance use disorders.

values.label: Psychosis
values.def: Schizophrenia-spectrum and bipolar populations.

values.label: Dermatology
values.def: Skin conditions including chronic itch, psoriasis, eczema, urticaria.

values.label: Metabolic / endocrine
values.def: Diabetes, obesity, thyroid, menopause.

values.label: Autoimmune / rheumatologic
values.def: RA, lupus, psoriatic arthritis, other immune-mediated disease.

values.label: Surgical patients
values.def: Patients undergoing surgery or invasive procedures (sham-surgery contexts).

values.label: Pediatric patients
values.def: Clinical samples under 18 y (combine with a condition tag).

values.label: Athletes
values.def: Trained or recreational athletes; exercise performance samples.

values.label: Clinicians / providers
values.def: Physicians, nurses, pharmacists, students as the surveyed population.

values.label: General public
values.def: Lay samples surveyed about placebo attitudes or beliefs.

values.label: Mixed clinical
values.def: Multiple clinical conditions pooled (typical of meta-analyses).

values.label: Other clinical
values.def: Clinical population not listed.

values.label: N/A
values.def: No sampled population (theory, methods).

values.label: Children / adolescents
values.def: Under 18 y.

values.label: Mixed / unspecified
values.def: Broad or unreported age range.

values.label: Pain
values.def: Experimental or clinical pain outcomes (analgesia, hyperalgesia).

values.label: Itch
values.def: Pruritus outcomes.

values.label: Nausea / GI
values.def: Nausea, motion sickness, gastric motility, bowel symptoms.

values.label: Motor function
values.def: Motor symptoms, strength, movement performance (e.g., Parkinson's, fatigue in exercise).

values.label: Mood / depression
values.def: Depressive symptoms and mood outcomes.

values.label: Anxiety / stress
values.def: Anxiety, stress reactivity, fear.

values.label: Fatigue
values.def: Fatigue and energy outcomes.

values.label: Sleep
values.def: Sleep quality, latency, insomnia symptoms.

values.label: Cognition
values.def: Memory, attention, executive function, cognitive enhancement.

values.label: Immune / inflammation
values.def: Cytokines, immune cell function, allergic response, conditioned immunosuppression.

values.label: Cardiovascular
values.def: Blood pressure, heart rate, cardiac outcomes.

values.label: Respiratory
values.def: Lung function, dyspnea, cough, asthma symptoms.

values.label: Endocrine / hormonal
values.def: Cortisol, growth hormone, insulin, sex hormones, oxytocin as outcomes.

values.label: Sport / exercise
values.def: Athletic or exercise performance, ergogenic placebo effects.

values.label: Sensory / perception
values.def: Taste, smell, vision, hearing, thermal perception outcomes other than pain/itch.

values.label: Appetite / metabolism
values.def: Hunger, satiety, ghrelin, glucose, weight.

values.label: Sexual function
values.def: Sexual desire, arousal, dysfunction outcomes.

values.label: Addiction / craving
values.def: Craving, drug effects under expectancy manipulation, alcohol/caffeine/nicotine placebo.

values.label: Adverse events
values.def: Side effects, drug discontinuation, symptom reporting after negative information.

values.label: Global health / QoL
values.def: Global improvement, quality of life, functioning.

values.label: Other
values.def: Domain not listed.

values.label: Self-report
values.def: Ratings, questionnaires, VAS/NRS, diaries.

values.label: Behavioral / performance
values.def: Reaction time, accuracy, tolerance, endurance, task performance.

values.label: Clinician-rated
values.def: Observer-rated scales (e.g., HAM-D, UPDRS).

values.label: Clinical endpoint
values.def: Disease markers, events, lab values, healing, relapse.

values.label: Autonomic
values.def: Heart rate/HRV, skin conductance, blood pressure, respiration, pupillometry.

values.label: Neuroendocrine
values.def: Cortisol, ACTH, oxytocin, catecholamines, other hormones.

values.label: Immune / inflammatory
values.def: Cytokines, immune cell assays, histamine, wheal/flare.

values.label: sMRI
values.def: Structural MRI (volume, thickness, DTI/diffusion).

values.label: fMRI
values.def: Functional MRI (task, resting-state, spinal, connectivity, MVPA).

values.label: PET (metabolism/flow)
values.def: FDG-PET, blood-flow PET.

values.label: PET (neurochemical)
values.def: Receptor-ligand PET (e.g., carfentanil, raclopride).

values.label: EEG / ERP
values.def: Scalp EEG, evoked potentials (incl. laser-evoked), intracranial EEG.

values.label: MEG
values.def: Magnetoencephalography.

values.label: NIRS
values.def: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy.

values.label: Spinal / peripheral electrophysiology
values.def: RIII reflex, EMG, nerve conduction, microneurography.

values.label: TMS physiology
values.def: Motor-evoked potentials or cortical excitability as outcome.

values.label: Motor / kinematic
values.def: Movement kinematics, force, gait, tremor recordings.

values.label: Genetic / molecular
values.def: Genotype, gene expression, epigenetics, microbiome.

values.label: Pharmacokinetic
values.def: Drug/metabolite concentrations.

values.label: Healthcare utilization
values.def: Medication use, visits, adherence, discontinuation, costs.

values.label: Other
values.def: Measure not listed.

values.label: N/A
values.def: No outcome measured.

values.label: Parallel-groups RCT
values.def: Participants randomized to placebo-context vs. control-context (or no-treatment) groups.

values.label: Crossover RCT
values.def: Each participant receives all conditions in randomized order.

values.label: Within-subject experimental
values.def: Placebo vs. control cues/sites/trials within person in a lab paradigm (e.g., conditioning + test).

values.label: Open-hidden
values.def: Overt vs. covert administration of an active treatment.

values.label: Balanced placebo design
values.def: 2x2 crossing of told-drug/told-placebo with received-drug/received-placebo.

values.label: Placebo vs. no-treatment arm
values.def: Trial including both a placebo arm and a natural-history/no-treatment arm.

values.label: Single-group pre/post
values.def: Placebo-arm change from baseline without an untreated control (placebo response).

values.label: Placebo-arm analysis
values.def: Analysis of placebo/sham arms from existing trials (predictors, trajectories, meta-regression).

values.label: Observational
values.def: Cohort, cross-sectional, case-control, or naturalistic data.

values.label: Survey / qualitative
values.def: Questionnaire, interview, or focus-group study.

values.label: Animal experiment
values.def: Controlled experiment in non-human animals.

values.label: Computational modeling
values.def: Model fitting or simulation as the primary design.

values.label: Meta-analytic
values.def: Pooled analysis across studies.

values.label: N/A
values.def: No study design (theory, commentary).

values.label: Effect on subjective
values.def: Statistically reliable placebo/nocebo effect or response on self-report outcomes.

values.label: Effect on objective
values.def: Reliable effect on physiological, neural, behavioral, or clinician-rated/clinical outcomes.

values.label: Null on subjective
values.def: No reliable effect on self-report outcomes.

values.label: Null on objective
values.def: No reliable effect on objective outcomes.

values.label: Mixed
values.def: Effects present for some outcomes/conditions/subgroups but not others, or moderated.

values.label: N/A
values.def: No effect estimate (protocol, theory, methods).

values.label: Expectation / suggestion
values.def: Verbal instructions or induced expectancies as the manipulated or measured mechanism.

values.label: Conditioning
values.def: Pharmacological or experiential conditioning procedures (incl. subliminal/unconscious).

values.label: Social learning
values.def: Observing others, peer models, social information.

values.label: Open-label placebo
values.def: Placebo given honestly without deception.

values.label: Treatment cues (dose/route/price/brand)
values.def: Pill color, number, price, branding, route, invasiveness, device appearance.

values.label: Provider-patient interaction
values.def: Empathy, warmth, competence, communication style, therapeutic alliance.

values.label: Ritual / context
values.def: Setting, ritual, symbolic features of care.

values.label: Opioid system
values.def: Endogenous opioid involvement (naloxone, PET, genetics).

values.label: Dopamine system
values.def: Dopaminergic involvement (reward, Parkinson's, PET).

values.label: Other neurochemistry
values.def: Endocannabinoid, CCK, oxytocin, vasopressin, serotonin, immune signaling.

values.label: Neural systems
values.def: Brain regions/circuits, descending modulation, spinal mechanisms, neural signatures.

values.label: Genetics
values.def: Genetic variation associated with placebo/nocebo responses.

values.label: Computational / predictive processing
values.def: Bayesian, reinforcement-learning, or predictive-coding accounts and model fits.

values.label: Emotion / anxiety
values.def: Anxiety reduction, affect, reward/relief as mediators.

values.label: Attention / appraisal
values.def: Attention, interpretation, mindset, self-efficacy, control.

values.label: Prior experience / learning history
values.def: Treatment history, previous response or failure, carry-over.

values.label: Side-effect communication
values.def: Informed consent framing, side-effect disclosure, framing and nocebo.

values.label: Media / social contagion
values.def: Media reports, mass psychogenic illness, generic-switch nocebo, social spread.

values.label: Clinical use / ethics / attitudes
values.def: Prevalence of placebo prescribing, ethics, deception, patient and clinician attitudes.

values.label: Trial methodology
values.def: Placebo response magnitude/trends in RCTs, blinding, run-in, expectation assessment, design recommendations.

values.label: Harnessing placebo effects
values.def: Interventions that leverage expectation/context to improve outcomes (dose-extending, communication training).

values.label: History / concepts
values.def: Definitions, history, philosophy of placebo.

values.label: Other
values.def: Mechanism or topic not listed.

values.label: Neurostimulation
values.def: TMS/tDCS/tACS/DBS used to modulate the placebo effect.

values.label: Pharmacological manipulation
values.def: Drugs (naloxone, proglumide, diazepam, etc.) used to block or enhance the effect.

values.label: Personality
values.def: Optimism, suggestibility, neuroticism, absorption, etc.

values.label: Genetics
values.def: Genotype as moderator.

values.label: Sex / gender
values.def: Sex or gender differences.

values.label: Age
values.def: Age as moderator.

values.label: Culture / ethnicity
values.def: Cross-cultural or ethnic differences.

values.label: Prior experience
values.def: Learning history, previous treatment success/failure.

values.label: Mood / anxiety state
values.def: State affect, stress, or anxiety as moderator.

values.label: Expectation level
values.def: Measured or induced strength of expectation.

values.label: Provider characteristics
values.def: Clinician warmth, competence, status, gender.

values.label: Treatment characteristics
values.def: Route, invasiveness, price, brand, dose frequency.

values.label: Disease severity / duration
values.def: Baseline severity, chronicity.

values.label: Trial characteristics
values.def: Number of arms, allocation ratio, trial year, sample size, contact frequency.

values.label: None
values.def: No moderator analysis.

values.label: Pill / capsule
values.def: Oral inert tablet or capsule.

values.label: Injection / infusion
values.def: Saline or inert injection/IV.

values.label: Topical
values.def: Inert cream, gel, patch.

values.label: Sham device
values.def: Inactive device (e.g., sham TENS, laser, magnet).

values.label: Sham surgery
values.def: Simulated surgical or invasive procedure.

values.label: Sham acupuncture
values.def: Non-penetrating or off-point needling.

values.label: Sham neurostimulation
values.def: Sham TMS/tDCS/DBS as the placebo.

values.label: Sham psychological / attention control
values.def: Inert psychological intervention or attention placebo.

values.label: Digital / virtual
values.def: App, VR, or online placebo; digital OLP.

values.label: Open-label placebo
values.def: Placebo administered with disclosure.

values.label: Active drug + context manipulation
values.def: Real drug delivered with varied expectation/context (open-hidden, balanced placebo, dose-extending).

values.label: Suggestion only
values.def: Expectation manipulated without a physical placebo vehicle.

values.label: Food / drink
values.def: Placebo beverage or food (caffeine, alcohol, supplement placebo).

values.label: Sham physical therapy
values.def: Sham manual therapy, exercise, or physiotherapy.

values.label: Other
values.def: Vehicle not listed.

values.label: N/A
values.def: No placebo administered (surveys, theory).
